items.title: 67251_Chuck Green oral history interview
items.q: Chuck and Chuckles was with the Don Redmond Orchestra and show

ctx.x: Tell me about the story you told me.

Well, once upon a time, as time came on or came by or passed, he eventually got into moving pictures with Shirley Temple, the child actress star. He used to teach her. He used to do choreography for him and her. And he called it terpsichore, he said, and he would make up these dance routines, tap dances, you know, like the adult and the child tap dances, and Shirley Temple and Bill Bojangles Robinson. Like they did the melody, "Bojangles of Harlem", and that went, (Singing), "Old Bojangles of Harlem," they were…

Baby Lawrence, and he used to take us to the gaming room, and he was teaching us how to shoot pool, how to play position with the cue ball. In other words, how to run the largest amount of balls. You have to put them in the pockets. And they were considered as points. Well, Mr. Bill Bojangles Robinson, he would like to wager, you see, so he figured that Mr. Don Redmond, being a band leader, the orchestra leader, and famous, with the (Unintelligible), the jazz giants, you see, he would make a wager. He would give…
